We need to propose a 5-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

We need to produce JSON route with 5 reactions. Need to find appropriate templates for each step: likely steps: 1) deprotect TBS (if present). The target has O-? Actually target has O[C@H]1... seems a protected alcohol? The O attached to ring maybe free OH? The SMILES: O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O. There is an O attached to chiral carbon (hydroxyl). Also O[C@@H]... is an ether linking to side chain with allylic chain and carboxylic acid. No TBS present. But we can propose protecting steps in forward synthesis, but retrosynthesis we need to break down.

We need to find templates: maybe use Still-Gennari to form Z-alkene linking side chain to carboxylic acid? The side chain includes C(O)=O at end (carboxylic acid). The chain: ...C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O is a conjugated diene with terminal carboxylic acid (maybe from HWE). So step could be HWE (Still-Gennari) to form that double bond from aldehyde and phosphonate.

Also there is an allylic alcohol side chain (CO) attached to double bond: /C=C(CO)/C indicates a vinyl alcohol side chain (hydroxyethyl). That could be from DIBAL reduction of ester to aldehyde then HWE? Actually DIBAL reduces ester to aldehyde, then HWE forms alkene with phosphonate to give unsaturated acid.

Also there is a cyclic acetal? The core is a tetrahydropyran ring with two O substituents (maybe protected). Could be formed via TBS protection then deprotection later.

We need 5 steps. Let's design:

Target (T0)

Step5 (last forward) maybe deprotect TBS to give free OH. So retrosynthetic step: remove TBS -> precursor with O-TBS group.

Thus retrosynthesis step5: target -> precursor A (with O-TBS). Use TBS deprotection template (break O-Si bond, form aliphatic hydroxyl). Need template ID for TBS deprotection. We can search.
